description: This file defines the FunctionalTensorWrapper class used in PyTorch's functionalization pass to remove aliasing and mutations from tensors, facilitating backend support for non-aliasing backends like XLA and Vulkan. It includes methods for managing tensor metadata, mutations, views, and integration with PyTorch's dispatch system.

classes.name: FunctionalTensorWrapper
classes.description: A wrapper around TensorImpl that manages functionalization metadata, aliasing, mutations, and views for tensors in PyTorch's functionalization pass.

classes.name: FunctionalizationReapplyViewsGuard
classes.description: A guard class that manages thread-local state for reapplying views during functionalization.

methods.name: value
methods.description: Returns the underlying tensor that does not know about functionalization.

methods.name: set_level
methods.description: Sets the level of the tensor, used by functorch.

methods.name: has_metadata_mutation
methods.description: Checks if the tensor has undergone metadata mutation.

methods.name: mutation_counter
methods.description: Returns the mutation counter from functional storage.

methods.name: mark_mutation
methods.description: Marks the tensor as mutated.

methods.name: mark_mutation_hidden_from_autograd
methods.description: Marks mutations as hidden from autograd.

methods.name: mark_mutation_during_no_grad_or_inference_mode
methods.description: Marks mutations during no_grad or inference mode.

methods.name: are_all_mutations_hidden_from_autograd
methods.description: Checks if all mutations are hidden from autograd.

methods.name: are_all_mutations_under_no_grad_or_inference_mode
methods.description: Checks if all mutations occurred under no_grad or inference mode.

methods.name: maybe_mark_symbolic
methods.description: Marks the tensor as symbolic if the meta indicates symbolic inputs.

methods.name: is_symbolic
methods.description: Checks if the tensor is marked as symbolic.

methods.name: view_metas
methods.description: Retrieves the sequence of view metadata for the tensor.

methods.name: sync_
methods.description: Syncs the underlying tensor with its alias if out of date.

methods.name: regenerate_from_base
methods.description: Regenerates the tensor from its base tensor.

methods.name: apply_updates
methods.description: Applies pending updates/mutations to the tensor.

methods.name: commit_update
methods.description: Snapshots current state and updates the alias.

methods.name: is_up_to_date
methods.description: Checks if the tensor is up-to-date with its alias.

methods.name: freeze_storage
methods.description: Freezes the tensor's storage to prevent mutations.

methods.name: mutate_view_meta
methods.description: Appends a view meta to the tensor's view sequence.

methods.name: set__impl
methods.description: Custom implementation of set_() for the wrapper.

methods.name: storage_resize_
methods.description: Custom implementation of resize_storage_bytes_().

methods.name: has_data_mutation
methods.description: Checks if the tensor's data was mutated.

methods.name: mark_storage_changed
methods.description: Marks the storage as changed.

methods.name: storage_changed_counter
methods.description: Returns the storage change counter.

methods.name: isBaseTensor
methods.description: Checks if the tensor is a base tensor (not a view).

methods.name: maybe_replace_storage
methods.description: Replaces storage with a new functional storage.

methods.name: _unsafe_reset_storage
methods.description: Replaces storage and clears view metas, severing aliasing.

methods.name: shallow_copy_and_detach
methods.description: Creates a detached copy of the tensor implementation.
